strings: While the worst of m_c's recovery has passed, r_c0 still worries about the damage to {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} lungs.
To everyone's relief, m_c's breathing has evened out. Still, r_c0 warns {PRONOUN/m_c/object} that {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} lungs just might not be as strong as before.
With the ash and smoke free from m_c's pelt and lungs, it's become obvious that it did a lot more than surface damage.
Due to the effects of ashcough, m_c's lungs have weakened and now a rasp is present in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} every breath.
